name: pack-layout-aware-guard
title: Ship a layout-aware review guard so consumers stop reimplementing one
description: Ship one pack-owned, layout-aware review guard so consumers can delete their bespoke reimplementations instead of porting them. Five consumers each wrote their own pack-layout guard; those scripts and the tests pinning them carry 330 of the fleet's 510 thin-conversion blockers.
